headline: Flagler finish their schedule beaten only once
dek: Flagler's only defeat came at Florida Southern in September, and they won every match after it, the last at home to Lynn. They finish with fifteen wins and four draws, having conceded nineteen goals. North Georgia, the only side to draw with them in conference play, closed at Catawba with a defeat.
displaced_by: Flagler have now played Lynn and North Georgia have played at Catawba, so the standing dek's matches still to come are no longer true, and no match remains on the calendar.
